title: Circumspection
author: Sarbani Chakravarti
text:
Fear, be my gatekeeper,
Let Hope not enter.
He is the harbinger of disaster.

The castle is deserted; the weather is still,
Birds sing not; no moonlight,
Owls and bats perch in pitch darkness;
Vision of the dark tastes glory in solitude,
Blinding light pains darkness and the inhabitants alike.

A flash of light, burning torches, make people restless
They dance like fools.
Soon light fades, too tired they become
To dance; darkness makes people falter and fall.

People lie and waste away,
As if they never had been!
